observations: Photo 0 shows a single upholstered sofa/loveseat in cream/beige fabric with a curved channel-tufted backrest design.
Indoor setting with a wood-paneled wall, a small potted plant, and tiled floor visible.
A watermark reading 'KENN PETERS' overlays the image.
No brand tag, label, or model number is visible anywhere in the photo.
Only one angle is shown; no close-up of fabric texture, legs, underside, or back of the sofa.
No tape measure or reference object is present to verify stated size.

claims.evidence: No way to verify age of furniture from a single photo; no receipt, purchase date, or wear-pattern close-up shown.
No measuring tape or reference object in photo 0 to confirm length claim.

risks.risk: Fabric condition: stains, tears, discoloration, or odor not visible at this angle/resolution.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seat cushions, armrests, and back from multiple angles in good lighting.
risks.if_unproven: priced as visibly used with unknown stains/wear (worst case for cosmetic condition)

risks.risk: Structural integrity: frame sagging, broken springs, or wobbly/damaged legs not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of underside and legs, plus a short clip of someone sitting on it.
risks.if_unproven: priced as structurally unverified (worst case: possible frame/spring issue)

risks.risk: Actual dimensions may not match '4 feet' claim.
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure laid along the length of the sofa.
risks.if_unproven: priced using the smaller/standard loveseat size assumption, not the claimed length

risks.risk: Pest infestation or odor (bedbugs, mustiness) common in used upholstered furniture, invisible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up of seams/crevices and a verbal/video confirmation of smell-free condition, ideally from an in-person agent.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified hygiene risk (worst case: assume treatment/cleaning needed)

risks.risk: Only one sofa piece appears in photo; buyer may expect a full set based on ambiguous listing.
risks.proof: Additional photos confirming whether this is a single loveseat or part of a matching set.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single standalone 2-seater only

proof_requests: Close-up photos of all cushions, armrests, and backrest for stains/tears.
Photo of the sofa's underside and legs.
Photo with a tape measure showing actual length.
Short video of someone sitting on it to show firmness/structural soundness.
Wider shot showing if this is a single piece or part of a set.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used 2-seater fabric sofa; lacking proof of condition, age, and exact size, it must be priced at worst case for cosmetic/structural condition until further photos are provided.
